## Why?

<!--
Required. The problem this solves, in your own words — not a restatement of the diff.

## Verification

<!--
`mise run ci` covers lint, typecheck, and tests. Say what it cannot see: a command you
ran by hand, behaviour you checked, a case you deliberately left untested.
-->

## Docs

<!--
Documentation moves with the change — stale framing is a defect, not a follow-up. Name
what you touched, or `none — no doc describes this`.
-->
